trigger: confined caller (or one confined after dispatch) reads GET /api/v1/executions/{id} as the execution's original dispatcher
summary: Dispatcher-ownership (owns_execution) granted durable, unredacted access to scope_expression/parameter_values/counts/last_error_detail regardless of the caller's CURRENT fleet-read scope. Fixed: owns_execution now only affects the visibility/404 decision; the confined projection always applies when gate.scope is engaged.

trigger: confined caller's page lands on a raw LIMIT boundary with hidden rows past it
summary: Legacy server.cpp response list/export routes and MCP query_responses filtered scope AFTER the SQL LIMIT (ADR-0017 INV-3 violation) — a confined caller's page could come back short/empty despite visible rows past the LIMIT-truncated hidden ones. Fixed: resolved visible-agent set pushed into ResponseStore::query/query_by_execution via a new scope parameter and shared append_scope_clause helper, applied before ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET.

trigger: a cancelled or failed execution reaches a confined SSE subscriber's execution-completed sanitizer
summary: sanitize_execution_event_for_scope hardcoded {"status":"completed"} regardless of the actual outcome, so a cancelled/failed execution was misreported as completed to confined subscribers. Fixed: forwards the real status field, fixed fallback only on absent/malformed payload.

trigger: confined caller charts a >cap row fan-out spanning in- and out-of-scope agents via GET /api/v1/executions/{id}/visualization
summary: Visualization route still called ResponseStore::query with a fixed row cap and post-filtered scope AFTER the query, missing the INV-3 fix applied everywhere else in this same branch. Fixed with the same distinct_agent_ids-then-scope-push-down pattern.

trigger: an operator or auditor reads docs/user-manual/rbac.md, docs/user-manual/audit-log.md, docs/enterprise-readiness-soc2-first-customer.md, or rest-api.md's v1 visualization section
summary: Four docs (including an auditor-facing CAIQ/CC6.1 claim) still described the pre-#1634 'inert filter'/'#3699 open' state. Updated all four with the migrated state via append-only correction notes.

trigger: an agentic/API consumer reads the embedded OpenAPI descriptions for visualization/events/final-state-lookup with no mention of confinement
summary: Embedded OpenAPI descriptions said only 'Requires Response/Execution:Read' with no mention of confinement, redaction, or the no-existence-oracle 404 (A2/A3 discoverability gap). Added a confinement summary to each.

trigger: a reader of rest-api.md's legacy Responses (Legacy) section after this branch's own edits
summary: Author's own doc regression: legacy section still described a differentiated corrupt-store behavior (no-rows vs 503) instead of the single shared require_fleet_read failure posture (403 corrupt-but-open, 503 unavailable) all three readers now share.

trigger: an operator reads legacy /api/executions* (untouched by this branch)
summary: Legacy /api/executions* lacks the confinement its REST v1 twin now has. Pre-existing, not introduced or widened by this branch. Deferred to a tracked follow-up.

trigger: >10000-in-scope-agent management group on query/query_by_execution
summary: query/query_by_execution silently truncated the in-scope agent bind-list past 10000 with only a warn-log, no result_truncated_by_cap-style signal (aggregate() already had one at the time). Re-raised independently by sre in Gate 6 as BLOCKING (1634-g6-1) and fixed there — see that row for the actual resolution.

policy_floor: false-green test offered as closure evidence for a blocking finding
trigger: the two existing visualization 'management-group scope' tests, built and run against the pre-INV-3-fix commit
summary: Both existing scope tests passed UNCHANGED (22/22 assertions) against the unfixed post-filter code — proven by building the pre-fix commit in an isolated worktree. Only 2 total rows, far under the route's row cap, so they could not distinguish SQL-side scoping from post-fetch filtering. Added two new discriminating tests at the ResponseStore::query/query_by_execution seam (out-of-scope row sorted newer, limit=1).

trigger: MCP aggregate_responses / REST GET /api/v1/events tested only via a synthetic fleet_read_fn stub
summary: These surfaces' only scope tests used a synthetic fleet_read_fn rather than the real AuthRoutes+RbacStore+ManagementGroupStore composition every sibling surface already has. Added real-rig Bob/Alice tests for both.

trigger: a reader of the AggregateScope doc comment after this branch made query/query_by_execution consult it too
summary: Doc comment claimed row-returning readers 'never consult this', already stale before this branch and now directly contradicted by it. Rewritten.

trigger: include-order convention check on the new header
summary: Include-order nit (STL/third-party/project ordering). Fixed.

trigger: Gate 1 Resource Ledger review of the two new SSE callback-context resources
summary: Resource Ledger didn't itemize the two new SSE callback-context resources; underlying acquire/release code independently verified correct. Addended to the governance record.

trigger: an unrestricted (RBAC-off/global-permission) caller on any of the four no-existence-oracle visibility checks
summary: The four no-existence-oracle checks (GET /api/v1/executions/{id}, GET /api/v1/events, GET /sse/executions/{id}, MCP get_execution_status) fetched and scanned agent statuses unconditionally, including for unrestricted callers where the check is unreachable-relevant. Guarded behind if (gate.scope), restoring the pre-migration zero-cost path for the common case.

trigger: an agentic caller reasons about fleet-completeness from query_responses/aggregate_responses' tools/list description
summary: MCP tool descriptions (A5 agentic-context contract, served verbatim via tools/list) still said the management-group filter 'is INERT under the current global Response:Read gate' — the machine-facing twin of the stale doc claim already fixed in prose docs. Updated all 4 affected tool descriptions (query_responses, aggregate_responses, get_execution_status, list_executions).

trigger: a suppressed cross-operator access attempt against GET /api/v1/executions/{id} or GET /api/v1/events's invisible-vs-nonexistent 404
summary: Both REST routes had no audit row at all on the 404 branch, unlike every sibling surface (MCP get_execution_status already audits denied there) — no forensic trail for a suppressed cross-operator read. Added a denied audit call on both using the same non-distinguishing detail text as the get_agent_details precedent (#1700/#3558), so no enumeration oracle reopens through query_audit_log.

trigger: the visualization route's scope_dropped signal, compared against every other scope-drop site's paired denied+success audit shape
summary: Visualization route folded scope_dropped into the SUCCESS audit detail instead of the sibling result=denied row every other scope-drop site uses. Fixed to the same paired denied+success shape.

trigger: fleet-read scope is captured once at SSE subscribe time with no mid-stream re-validation
summary: A scope narrowed (or session revoked) mid-stream doesn't disconnect an already-open SSE subscriber. Verified against the pre-migration code: this branch only added an OR-condition alongside the existing check, never changed the timing. Not introduced/worsened; documented in docs/auth-architecture.md's Still-open list this same round (see the SSE staleness note) rather than fixed here.

trigger: a degraded execution-tracker read on an execution id that is genuinely absent
summary: A degraded tracker read is folded into the same 404 as a genuinely-absent execution. Verified pre-existing against the pre-migration code (this branch only added an OR-condition, never changed the nullopt-conflation). Not introduced/worsened; recommended as a tracked follow-up, not fixed here.

trigger: a confined session's username is ever empty (no live path produces this today)
summary: ExecutionQuery::dispatched_by empty-string is its own no-filter sentinel; an empty confined username would silently widen list_executions to unfiltered instead of narrowing to zero rows — the wrong failure direction for a confinement check. Added an explicit fail-closed guard even though no live path produces this today.

trigger: a management group with more than 10000 visible agents calls query/query_by_execution/aggregate
summary: append_scope_clause bound one SQL placeholder per agent behind a 10000-agent cap: query/query_by_execution silently dropped rows past it, and aggregate() silently under-counted with no indicator at all (I3, wrong result presented as correct). Fixed by replacing the per-agent placeholder loop with a single ANY($n::text[]) bind via the existing pg::to_text_array helper (same pattern already used by this file's facet_values/facet_agent_count) — removes the cap entirely rather than raising it; no truncation is possible by construction. Added a query/aggregate discriminating test past 10000 agents and an agent-id-escaping test.

trigger: a spike in cross-operator (scope-dropped) access attempts on any migrated surface
summary: Every scope-drop site emits an audit row (result=denied) but no Prometheus counter, so a spike is invisible without querying the audit log (ADR-0017 INV-9 satisfied on the log half only). Recommend one bounded-label counter (surface, closed set) fed from the sites already computing scope_dropped/scope_filtered. Not fixed this round; deferred to a tracked follow-up per the run's SHOULD-tier policy.

trigger: the CH-5 fail-closed guard (empty confined username) actually fires in production
summary: CH-5's guard logs spdlog::error only, with no dedicated always-zero counter — alerting-invisible as shipped, matching the 'any movement = fault' pattern used elsewhere (yuzu_rotation_sweep_lock_skipped_total precedent). Not fixed this round; deferred to a tracked follow-up.

trigger: an operator needs to force-disconnect one live SSE subscriber (e.g. after a scope change or session revocation)
summary: invalidate_session only erases the session record; it never reaches an already-open httplib SSE connection, so no lever exists to force-disconnect one live /api/v1/events or /sse/executions/{id} subscriber short of a full server restart. Documented as a runbook-worthy gap in docs/auth-architecture.md's Still-open list this round (folds with compliance-officer's F3 SSE-staleness note); not code-fixed this round.

trigger: four workflow_routes.cpp/rest_api_v1.cpp dashboard/REST routes' 404 branches, compared against every sibling denied-audit call
summary: /fragments/executions/{id}/detail and /sse/executions/{id} (dashboard routes) were missing the same denied-audit row Gate 4 had already added to the two REST siblings. Added denied audit calls to both 404 branches (execution.detail.view, execution.live_subscribe), verified against the existing success-path action names.

trigger: a reviewer looking for this run's findings record
summary: No governance.d/ ledger fragment existed for this run despite the mandatory Gate 8 recording requirement. This fragment is that record.

trigger: a customer-facing operator reads docs/user-manual/rest-api.md's GET /sse/executions/{id} or GET /api/v1/events sections
summary: Both customer-facing REST SSE sections were never updated with the confinement/redaction/no-existence-oracle behavior already documented for the MCP siblings in docs/mcp-server.md/docs/user-manual/mcp.md. Added the confinement gate paragraph, the 404-collapse language, the audit-denied clause, and the per-event drop/sanitize table to both sections.

trigger: a reader of docs/capability-map.md section 18.4
summary: Section 18.4 still said list/fan-out confinement (agent lists, responses, inventory) was 'not yet effective', stale after #1634. Updated to name the now-migrated response/execution family and narrow the remaining-open claim to agent lists/inventory.

trigger: a SIEM engineer reads rest-api.md's Audit action names table rows for execution.live_subscribe/api.v1.events.subscribe, which still claimed success-only / no-audit-on-denial after this branch's own denied-audit fix
summary: Same-file audit-table contradiction: the two action-name-reference table rows still described the pre-#1634 no-denied-audit behavior, directly contradicted by this branch's own new prose 4800 lines later in the same file. Fixed both rows to describe the denied path.

trigger: a CC6.1 reviewer reads capability-map.md 18.4's 'remaining list/fan-out surfaces (agent lists, inventory)' claim
summary: Overbroad claim: query_installed_software/GET /api/v1/inventory/software have been confined since #3290 Phase 2, predating this branch. This commit had the exact opportunity (it rewrote this sentence) to narrow the claim but didn't. Fixed to name the effectively-confined inventory surface and narrow the remaining-open claim to agent lists + the generic blob inventory routes.

trigger: a reader of the new denied-audit call comments in workflow_routes.cpp, which claimed parity with the REST twins' audit action names
summary: Comment overstated: dashboard routes keep their own pre-existing action names (execution.detail.view, execution.live_subscribe) rather than adopting the REST twins' (execution.detail.fetch, api.v1.events.subscribe) — internally consistent (matches each route's own success row) but the comment claimed more parity than exists. Detail-text/result-value parity (the actual security property) is real and unaffected. Reworded both comments to state the real relationship.

trigger: the /fragments/executions/{id}/detail route's new denied-audit call, added same-round as the SSE route's (which got a test), had zero regression coverage
summary: Missing test: 'executions detail: admitted-but-deny_all() non-owner gets collapsed 404' asserted the 404 body/status but not the new denied-audit row. Added the same saw_denied assertion pattern already used for the SSE route's twin test.

trigger: a developer reads response_store.hpp's AggregateScope/query() doc comments after this branch's ANY($n::text[]) rewrite
summary: Doc comments at lines 128 and 234 still said 'agent_id IN (...)', now inconsistent with the actual ANY($n::text[]) implementation (and with lines 301/325 in the same file, which already used the correct form). Fixed both.

trigger: a SIEM query filters target_type='Execution' (capitalized) across the #1634 confinement family
summary: execution.visualization.fetch's audit rows use lowercase 'execution' as target_type while the other four #1634 sites use 'Execution'. Row exists and is correctly named; a case-sensitive filter under-correlates, not a lost row. Pre-existing in an earlier round of this same branch, not introduced by 1015f49a6. Not fixed this round; low priority, no issue filed (cosmetic, no data-loss risk).

trigger: a future store author looks for guidance on the unbounded-scope read-path idiom before reinventing #1634's original defect
summary: pg::to_text_array is documented only in its batched-INSERT role; the ANY($n::text[]) read-path idiom this fix now uses (matching facet_values/facet_agent_count precedent) isn't recorded as canonical guidance. Filed as issue #3790 rather than fixed inline (doc-playbook scope, not this PR's diff).

trigger: a reader compares the new escaping test's design intent against what it actually discriminates
summary: The double-quote/comma escaping test is real and useful (guards a future to_text_array regression) but does not itself discriminate pre-fix vs post-fix code (a single-element scope never exercised the old per-placeholder cap). Framing-only; not fixed, noted for the record.

trigger: query_by_execution shares append_scope_clause with query/aggregate but has no independent >10000-agent test of its own
summary: Coverage gap: query_by_execution is byte-identical to query's call of append_scope_clause, so risk is low, but isn't independently proven by a dedicated test. Not fixed this round (low risk, not requested as blocking); acceptable to leave uncovered given the shared-helper structure.

trigger: Gate 8 re-review of commit 1015f49a6 (the Gate 6 fix round) by 11 agents: cpp-expert, cpp-safety, security-guardian, docs-writer, architect, sre, compliance-officer, enterprise-readiness, consistency-auditor, happy-path, unhappy-path
summary: All 11 Gate 8 agents reported PASS with zero BLOCKING/HIGH findings. sre independently re-ran the two new discriminating tests against real Postgres rather than trusting the commit message; security-guardian independently verified pg::to_text_array's escaping is injection-safe and re-ran the audit-parity test. 9 real non-blocking findings surfaced (2 docs-writer, 2 compliance-officer, 2 consistency-auditor, 1 architect, 2 happy-path); 4 fixed inline this round (g8-1..4), 1 fixed as a doc-comment nit (g8-5), 1 filed as a follow-up issue (g8-7 -> #3790), 1 deferred with no issue (g8-6, cosmetic), 2 accepted as-is / not actionable (g8-8, g8-9). Full suite re-verified green after the g8-1..5 fixes.
